ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $UserRole.DeveloperName == 'Back-office', OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Promotion_Type__c)), ISPICKVAL(Market__c, ''), ISBLANK(StartDate), ISBLANK(EndDate), ISBLANK(Influence_Date__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For back office users, Promotion Type, Market, Start Date, End Date, and Influence Date are required.
